// case, functions, here-documents: all in BusyBox ash.
$ for a in x.sh bot.arm7 y; do case $a in *.sh) echo script;; bot.*|*.bin) echo binary ;; *) echo other; esac; done
script
binary
other
$ case "a b" in "a b") echo quoted;; esac; case x in (x) echo paren; esac
quoted
paren
$ f() { echo "f got $# args: $1 $0"; return 3; }; f a b; echo $?
f got 2 args: a -sh
3
$ g() { local x=inner; echo $x; }; x=outer; g; echo $x
inner
outer
$ function h { echo bash-style; }; h
bash-style
$ sh -c 'k() { exit 4; }; k; echo not reached'; echo $?
4
$ name=world; cat <<EOF
< hello $name
<   "quoted" $(echo sub)
< EOF
> hello $name
>   "quoted" $(echo sub)
> EOF
hello world
  "quoted" sub
$ cat <<'EOF'
< literal $name
< EOF
> literal $name
> EOF
literal $name
$ cat <<-EOF
< 	tabs stripped
< 	EOF
> 	tabs stripped
> 	EOF
tabs stripped
$ echo foo | read v; echo "[$v]"
[]
$ a=(1 2)
sh: syntax error: unexpected "("
[exit 2]
$ f(
sh: syntax error: unexpected "("
[exit 2]
